name: codex-limits
description: Codex five-hour and weekly quota remaining, with live reset countdowns in the status bar.

codexLimits.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Usage polling interval in seconds (default: 60). Changes apply immediately. Reset countdowns update every 15 seconds.

codexLimits.showWeeklyReset.description: Show the weekly reset countdown alongside the weekly remaining percentage.

codexLimits.codexHome.description: Optional absolute path to the directory containing Codex auth.json. Defaults to CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Credentials are read only; this extension never renews or writes them.

codexLimits.warningThresholdPercent.description: Highlight the status bar when either usage limit window has this percentage or less remaining.

codexLimits.underUsageThresholdPercentag.description: How many percentage points, above the percent time left in this usage limit, are considered under usage.

codexLimits.overUsageThresholdPercentage.description: How many percentage points, below the percent time left in this usage limit, are considered over usage.
